sources.entry: Open-WebUI - User-friendly AI Interface, supports Ollama, OpenAI API. (Source Code) BSD-3-Clause Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: Open WebUI is a self-hosted, extensible AI platform and web interface that works with Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs for local and cloud models.
summary.what_it_does: Open WebUI provides a browser-based chat interface for running AI models, connecting to local Ollama models and any OpenAI-compatible API such as LMStudio, OpenRouter, vLLM, and Mistral. It can be installed via pip, Docker (with :main, :cuda, or :ollama bundled images), Kubernetes, Docker Compose, Kustomize, or Helm. The README describes role-based access control with user groups, a plugin system (Filters, Actions, Pipes, Tools, MCP/MCPO and OpenAPI tool servers), and custom model agents. It also lists built-in RAG with multiple vector databases and document extraction engines, web search through many providers, image generation, voice/video calls, and calendar and automation features. Enterprise-oriented items include LDAP/Active Directory, OAuth/SSO, SCIM 2.0 provisioning, OpenTelemetry, and Redis-backed horizontal scaling. The README also points to companion projects (Open Terminal, desktop app, oikb).
use_cases: Chatting with local Ollama models through a web interface
Using OpenAI-compatible cloud APIs from one self-hosted front end
Building custom AI agents with tools and knowledge bases
Chatting with my own documents via retrieval-augmented generation
Team access to AI models with user roles and groups
Running a private AI chat server on my own hardware
how_to_run: docker run -d -p 3000:8080 --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v open-webui:/app/backend/data --name open-webui --restart always ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main
docker run -d -p 3000:8080 -e OPENAI_API_KEY=your_secret_key -v open-webui:/app/backend/data --name open-webui --restart always ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main
notable: Provider-agnostic: connects Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible API, including mixing local and cloud models
Plugin system with Filters, Actions, Pipes, Tools, and MCP/MCPO/OpenAPI tool server support
RAG with 9 vector database options and hybrid BM25 plus vector search with reranking
Enterprise auth options: LDAP/Active Directory, SSO via trusted headers and OAuth, SCIM 2.0 provisioning
Official images tagged :ollama (bundled Ollama) and :cuda (GPU support)
caveats: The README says the project contains code under multiple licenses, including an Open WebUI License that requires preserving the 'Open WebUI' branding; the metadata lists BSD-3-Clause, so check LICENSE and LICENSE_HISTORY
Some features are labeled Enterprise (e.g., Terminals (Enterprise)) and an Enterprise Plan is offered through sales
The :dev tag contains unstable features and may have bugs
Docker setups may need extra configuration to reach Ollama; the README suggests --network=host in connection-error cases
